## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home is built and lives in its own private repo, `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home` (3 commits, history limited to the exercise). It has a compose stack that builds `flaky-svc` from source, a broken alert rule, a connection leak, an over-broad IAM policy in Terraform, a 3-hour time box and no Kubernetes. The rubric has four areas scored 0–3, with no cut-off, and Noa is the second reviewer. Nothing has been sent to the candidate.

- [en-cours] Removing `hiring/` from the `maya/sre-take-home` working tree: done but not committed, no PR opened
- [prochaine-étape] After the Thursday 4pm call, send the exercise yourself (repo invite and README)
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch build with `--load` failed: the docker exporter can't load manifest lists. The prebuilt amd64 image also broke on Apple Silicon, so `flaky-svc` now builds from source in compose
- [question] When to invite the candidate to the private repo
- [décision] 3-hour time box, Terraform and compose only, no Kubernetes (source: t03)
- [décision] Candidates build `flaky-svc` from source, no prebuilt image (source: t06)
- [décision] No pass threshold: scores are input for the panel, with Noa as second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] Exercise in its own private repo, not in infra (source: t12)
- [décision] Delete `hiring/` from the infra branch, no PR there (source: t14)
- [décision] Nothing emailed; you send the exercise yourself after the call (source: t16)
